Raise Georgia's minimum wage above $7.25; address child care costs and pay inequality.
Climate change is real; reduce reliance on oil and gas, invest in renewable energy.
Fully fund K-12 public schools, raise per-student funding and teacher pay; supports accurate historical curriculum.
Slow rising mortgage and rental costs, more affordable housing; expand MARTA and CobbLinc rather than relying on highway widening.

Jeff Mullis, who described him as pro-life, pro-gun and pro-law enforcement and as a man who acts on conservative principles (Chattanooga Times Free Press).
